findings.description: New contradiction created by the round-1 F-3 fix. FR-NODE-274 now defines tree_sha as the state a round's review read and states in its own notes that a round ends with its fixes, so a diff from one round's end to the next review is empty. FR-FLOW-229 AC-1 and FR-FLOW-171 AC-1 and AC-8 still define the round-N scope and denominator as the diff 'from the end of round N-1' / 'since the end of the previous round'. Under the SRS's own definition of a round end, that diff is empty: a skill test written from 229 AC-1 would fix an empty round-2 scope, and FR-NODE-274 AC-2 would then report a scope failure for every file round N-1's fixes changed. The note's claim that 229/171 'mean' the review-start diff is a reinterpretation, not what the AC text says. Fix: reword 229 AC-1 and 171 AC-1, AC-8 to the change since round N-1's review began (between the tree_sha values of FR-NODE-274 AC-1).

evidence.detail: docs/spec/50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:18530 'a round ends with its fixes, and the next round's review starts from that same state, so a diff from one round's end to the next review is empty' vs docs/spec/60.workflow-release.srs.md:16182 'THE review scope SHALL default to the diff from the end of round N-1 plus every file that diff touches', :12222 'from round 2 ... it is the files of the diff since the end of the previous round', :12229 'from round 2 that range is the change since the end of the previous round'

findings.description: The round-2 scope check and denominator skip the code-only file-class filter. FR-NODE-274 AC-2 fails a since-prev round for every file that differs between the two recorded trees and is missing from files[], with no exemption for files the skill's section 11 disposes into excluded_prose, refused_artifacts or unclassified_files; files[] corresponds to self_scope.files[], which the skill defines as section 11's included bucket. The snapshot procedure uses git add -A, which takes every non-ignored file, and the run state lives at cwd/.kiwi/sessions/{run-id}/ while speckiwi writes no .gitignore entry for .kiwi/ in a consumer repository. Real input: a consumer repo without .kiwi/ in .gitignore. state.json (and worklog.jsonl, a refused *.jsonl journal) changes between round N-1's and round N's snapshot because round N-1's entry is written at its end, so AC-2 reports a scope failure in every round >= 2 and AC-4 never returns PASS for since-prev; the only way through is scope full with a reason every round, which defeats PRD-6. FR-FLOW-171 AC-1 likewise makes the round-2 denominator 'the files of the diff' without the filter, while round 1 uses the scope decision's included files, so implementing it literally puts prose and state files into the review denominator, contrary to FR-FLOW-152. Fix: apply the section 11 / FR-FLOW-152 disposition to the round-N diff and have AC-2 compare the diff files against all four buckets (or exempt the run's own .kiwi/ state).
